pre_result_data_quality_amendment: After checksum verification but before any signal or PnL computation, the public SOL archives were found to omit 2022-02-26 through 2022-02-28 and 2022-04-01 through 2022-04-02. The portfolio clock carries the last causal close, but those rows are permanently MTM-only: they cannot create a 4h/daily signal bar or execute an entry, exit, stop or time-stop. Counts are disclosed in data_quality.json. No strategy or risk parameter changed.
pre_data_amendment: v1.0 used only 14 months. Before loading any market data or observing any result, the horizon was enlarged to cover multiple trend regimes; no trading rule or execution parameter changed.

hypothesis.data: Binance USD-M public monthly archives; 5m execution candles and historical fundingRate; no exchange API, account or private data
hypothesis.bars: UTC closed 4h signal bars and UTC closed 1d regime bars built from complete 5m candles; a signal stamped T can execute no earlier than the 5m open at T
hypothesis.directional_regime: alt and BTC latest complete daily close must both be above EMA50 for long or both below EMA50 for short; EMA50 must also have moved in that direction versus three complete daily bars earlier
hypothesis.entry: first 4h close crossing above the prior 20 complete 4h highs for long or below the prior 20 complete 4h lows for short; market at next available 5m open
hypothesis.initial_stop: 2.0 x 4h Wilder ATR14 from the signal close; reject when actual fill-to-stop distance is outside 1.5-2.5 ATR
hypothesis.common_exit: market exit at the 5m open after a complete 4h close crosses the opposite prior-10 Donchian boundary; hard maximum hold 30 days; end-of-window liquidation
hypothesis.duplicate_control: require a breakout crossing from inside the prior channel; no repeated entry while price merely remains beyond a channel

predeclared_exit_policies.rule: initial structural/ATR stop remains unchanged until common exit
after a complete 4h close reaches at least +1.5 price-R, compute a round-trip fee-and-slippage-aware zero-PnL stop; it activates only on the next 5m bar and never loosens

same cost-BE; after a complete 4h close reaches at least +2.0 price-R, also trail at the best completed 4h extreme since entry minus/plus 2.5 current 4h ATR14; update activates only on the next 5m bar and never loosens

windows.genuine_oos: new data after 2026-09-01 under a frozen paper-forward protocol

promotion_gates.development_to_validation_per_policy: at least 30 closed trades, net PnL >0 and PF >1.05 in base costs; no least-bad policy advances
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation_p: at least 10 closed trades, base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, net PnL >0 in base and at least 2 traded symbols represented
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: not authorized by this retrospective test; require at least three full frozen prospective months and 50 closed trades, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% weekly-block bootstrap lower bound >0 and max drawdown <=6%

portfolio_and_risk.risk_per_trade: min(0.20% current cash, $0.50); halve new-trade risk after 4% peak drawdown; stop new entries after 6% peak drawdown
portfolio_and_risk.one_global_position: one shared cash balance and at most one open position across ETH/SOL/BNB
portfolio_and_risk.candidate_priority: highest normalized breakout distance first, then fixed ETH, SOL, BNB tie-break
portfolio_and_risk.realized_loss_controls: block new entries for the remainder of a UTC day after 0.6% loss from day-start cash and for the ISO week after 1.8% loss from week-start cash; never widen or prematurely liquidate an existing swing because of an intraday mark
portfolio_and_risk.funding: historical funding settlement rate applied to open perp notional with the Binance long/short sign; 5m open is a disclosed mark-price proxy
portfolio_and_risk.ambiguous_5m_bar: old active stop is checked before any close-derived stop update; stop/gap first; no same-bar benefit from a newly computed BE or Chandelier

selection: One fixed entry hypothesis and exactly three exit policies. No parameter grid. Each policy must pass every gate independently; do not promote the least negative result.
disclosure: No profit is promised. All historical windows are retrospective because related research already inspected these months. A positive result can authorize only frozen paper-forward observation, never live capital.
